question_vi: Server-side form validation vs client-side validation khi nào dùng cái nào?
question_en: When should you use server-side vs client-side form validation?
answer_vi: Client-side validation: UX tốt hơn, instant feedback, giảm unnecessary server requests. KHÔNG thể thay thế server-side vì user có thể bypass. Server-side validation: bắt buộc cho security, validate business rules phức tạp, kiểm tra database constraints. Best practice: cả hai - client để UX, server để security và correctness.
answer_en: Client-side validation: better UX, instant feedback, fewer unnecessary server requests. It CANNOT replace server-side validation because users can bypass it. Server-side validation: mandatory for security, enforcing complex business rules, and checking database constraints. Best practice: use both — client-side for UX, server-side for security and correctness.
